rules: Splits are assigned by source_family and near_duplicate_cluster_id, never by individual row/example.
All records sharing source_family OR near_duplicate_cluster_id MUST be in the same split.
Test split is locked before autonomous hyperparameter search; it must never enter search/tuning loops.
Dev split may be used for calibration/threshold locking only after integrity checks pass.
Train split may include verified self-play examples only when deterministically verified by independent LIR kernels.
Every ingestion run must log: read == accepted + rejected, manifest checksum verification, and split assignment audit.
Document-length weighting must be applied during training so long documents do not dominate loss.
